title: Living long and prospering: a Q&A special
content:
Abstract
This issue we decided to expand our usual back page Q&A into a celebration of some of the oldest statisticians we could find. The four formidable interviewees, drawn from the memberships of the Royal Statistical Society (RSS), American Statistical Association (ASA) and Statistical Society of Australia (SSA), grew up during the Second World War, witnessed some of the world’s most seismic shifts, and through their brilliance and dedication to their work have made a positive difference not just to the discipline of statistics but to the wider world – from democracy to health care. We thank them all.
